parameters.query: INSERT INTO helpdesk.notification_outbox (ticket_id,idempotency_key) VALUES ($1::uuid,$2) ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING outbox_id;
INSERT INTO helpdesk.review_tasks (ticket_id,reason_codes) SELECT $1::uuid,$2::jsonb WHERE $3::boolean ON CONFLICT (ticket_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING review_task_id;
